prompt: Which lambda correctly implements the Comparator<String> interface to sort by string length?
explanation: Comparator.compare(a, b) returns negative if a < b, 0 if equal, positive if a > b. a.length() - b.length() achieves this for length ordering. Option B sorts lexicographically by content (String::compareTo is a method reference to compareTo). Option C has wrong parameter count. Option D: > on String is a compile error.
